correctness.rationale: The proof derives interior nonadjacency from the recurrence and endpoint congruence; p-digit factorization then gives exact zero runs z a^(L-j-1). It counts neighboring admissible high prefixes by a carry decomposition as E_h=(p-1-2z)(a^h-1)/(a-1) and accounts for every merge of edge nonzero runs. All bases, end cases, and the z=0 branch are included; full exact-integer checker passed 125867 index instances. This is an infinite proof, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The previously motivated zeros of central trinomial sequences are classified by a genuinely structural consecutive-index invariant: either zero divisibility throughout, or zero-run lengths precisely powers of p with exact counts and a sharp bounded maximum for consecutive nondivisibility. The full two-sided run-length spectrum supplies information absent from a mere divisibility automaton or density, for every prime and every digit depth.
